create a new DELETE endpoint
`/v1/organizations/<organization_id>/saved-opportunities/<opportunity_id>`.

(screenshots, GIF demos, code examples or output). -->

-v"`, new tests should pass.

[Issue #8006] Create Read Endpoints for Phase 1 Opportunity Publishing (#8649)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Work for #8006 

## Changes proposed

<!-- What was added, updated, or removed in this PR. -->

Adding 2 Read Endpoints for the Opportunities - For Grantors section.

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->
Part of Opportunity Publishing MVP Phase 1 [(Tech
Spec)](https://navasage.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Grantsgov/pages/2612789251/Phase+1+Core+Foundations)

Opportunity Publishing in Simpler Grants will enable the creation of
funding opportunities directly into Simpler Grants. With this
capability, key opportunity data can be entered into Simpler Grants and
displayed to applicants in a consistent, unified experience. This PR is
focused on making the Read endpoints for doing the following:

- Given an Agency ID, return all opportunities (including drafts), given
that the user has the `view_opportunity` privilege for an opportunity’s
Agency.

- Given an Opportunity ID, returns a specific opportunity for editing
(given applicable `view_opportunity` privilege). This is for Grantors
and may contain additional fields that are hidden for Applicants.

Endpoint Information:

`POST /v1/grantors/agencies/{agency_id}/opportunities`
`GET /v1/grantors/opportunities/{opportunity_id}`

## Validation steps

<!-- Manual testing instructions, as well as any helpful references
(screenshots, GIF demos, code examples or output). -->
- [x] 11 New Unit test pass
- [x] Confirmed all expected request+responses on local
- [x] Confirmed all information populates in local DB

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Work for #8006 

## Changes proposed

<!-- What was added, updated, or removed in this PR. -->

Adding 2 Read Endpoints for the Opportunities - For Grantors section.

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->
Part of Opportunity Publishing MVP Phase 1 [(Tech
Spec)](https://navasage.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Grantsgov/pages/2612789251/Phase+1+Core+Foundations)

Opportunity Publishing in Simpler Grants will enable the creation of
funding opportunities directly into Simpler Grants. With this
capability, key opportunity data can be entered into Simpler Grants and
displayed to applicants in a consistent, unified experience. This PR is
focused on making the Read endpoints for doing the following:

- Given an Agency ID, return all opportunities (including drafts), given
that the user has the `view_opportunity` privilege for an opportunity’s
Agency.

- Given an Opportunity ID, returns a specific opportunity for editing
(given applicable `view_opportunity` privilege). This is for Grantors
and may contain additional fields that are hidden for Applicants.

Endpoint Information:

`POST /v1/grantors/agencies/{agency_id}/opportunities`
`GET /v1/grantors/opportunities/{opportunity_id}`
